text:
Maya (AE): quick one 1: Lumen Labs (seed, YC S23) asked to expand trial credits. originally 50k tokens, now need more for long-doc summarization + iterative image caption loops.

Ravi (SalesEng): estimate ~300k tokens if they run full tests over 2 weeks. throughput matters for benchmarking, latency less so.

Maya (AE): ask = +250k tokens + extend trial 30 days. no ARR yet. they signed TOU; SSQ pending.

Lina (DealDesk): we usually cap early-stage at 100k. Exceptions need signed addendum and deposit or CC preauth. Can they sign a pilot addendum?

Maya (AE): yes 1 legal name Lumen Labs Inc. contact ef@lumenlabs.ai. founders can do a light $5k prepay but limited budget.

Priya (RevOps): I can issue a one-time promo if conditions met: cap total at 300k, expiry 30d, signed addendum, and security ack on outstanding items. I need external_id to attach ledger.

security-bot: SSQ submitted for Lumen Labs Inc. status pending 1 missing: network diagram + data retention policy. link: https://sec.internal/q/AL-452

Tom (Finance): approved conditionally. addendum must state: "unused credits expire; any usage beyond credited amount billed at standard rates." finance wants exact language. Keep exposure low.

Lina (DealDesk): tentative approval: +250k conditional on signed addendum, sec signoff, and $1k refundable deposit or CC preauth. if sec stalls >72h we can consider a 100k temp bump with revocation.

Maya (AE): action items: get addendum signed + network diagram (48h). will update. Priya please standby to provision promo code once addendum is in place. Jon will do post-POC review. Thanks all.
